title: Missouri high court blocks redrawn GOP map, Trump calls it 'ridiculous'
shortDescription: After the Missouri Supreme Court blocked use of Republican-drawn maps for midterms in a Sept. 3 ruling, President Trump lashed out at the decision.

title: Work to begin on Trump arch project
shortDescription: Work is set to begin on Trump’s 250 foot arch as critics raise concerns about views near Washington landmarks.

title: Vance downplays 'Trumpapalooza' GOP no-shows
shortDescription: "That doesn't concern me," JD Vance said of Republicans opting out of the convention, adding that candidates in close races have a lot to juggle.

title: McConnell could return to the Senate soon after months-long absence
shortDescription: Sen. Mitch McConnell could return to the Senate later this month, Rep. James Comer said, after the former majority leader's lengthy absence.

title: Trump brings fight over mailed ballots back to Supreme Court
shortDescription: The Trump administration is again asking the Supreme Court to let the Postal Service tighten mail ballot rules before midterms.

title: Excavation to begin on Trump's arch despite criticism of memorial
shortDescription: Work is to start within two weeks on Trump's 250-foot memorial arch, Interior Secretary Doug Burgum announced.

title: Maria Bartiromo as White House press secretary? Vance doesn't think so.
shortDescription: JD Vance appeared to rule out Maria Bartiromo being named the next White House press secretary. "No, I don't think so," the vice president said.

title: Vance says he's not concerned about GOP convention no-shows
shortDescription: 'That doesn't concern me,' Vance said of Republicans opting out of the convention, adding candidates in close races have a lot to juggle.

title: Trump says 'I don't wear a wig' at White House Rose Garden dinner
shortDescription: President Donald Trump has yet again denied wearing a wig while speaking at a White House Rose Garden dinner on Sept. 2.

title: LA man charged for threatening to kill Trump, prosecutors say
shortDescription: Prosecutors alleged the 40-year-old also cyberstalked and harassed an attorney who'd been Trump's personal lawyer.

title: Trump wants Europe to pay US back
shortDescription: President Donald Trump says European countries should repay the U.S. for assistance and munitions provided to Ukraine during its war with Russia.

title: Ted Cruz tells Republicans to stop ‘whining’ over Ken Paxton
shortDescription: Cruz appeared on Fox News, arguing that moderates have long told conservatives to support the Republican nominee after losing a primary.

title: Trump preps for midterm travel blitz that includes a pitstop in Alaska
shortDescription: President Trump said he's launching an aggressive travel blitz in the final month of the midterm election as Republicans look to fend off a blue wave.

title: Ex-presidents to attend 9/11 memorial in NYC; Trump heads to Pentagon
shortDescription: Trump said he will visit the Pentagon on the 25th anniversary of the terrorist attacks, instead of the memorial ceremony at Ground Zero.

title: What is on Trump's schedule today? Plus, Trump on Tiger Woods, midterms
shortDescription: Trump said he will go to Alaska to campaign. He is glad that the Duke and Duchess of Sussex are going back to the UK. JD Vance will give a briefing today.

title: A new member of Congress made history. He'll be there 4 months.
shortDescription: Rep. Everton Blair will serve just four months in Congress. Still, the South's first Black gay man in the House has plans for his short time there.

title: Do Trump voters have regrets? 1 in 6 would change vote, poll finds
shortDescription: A new poll finds some Trump voters are having second thoughts, with 1 in 6 saying they would change their 2024 vote if they could.
